replacement_plans.name: Library of Congress Collections
replacement_routes: Retry the documented source API route with smaller page sizes and source-specific timeout/backoff.
Keep successful local records and treat this as a partial route failure, not a source-wide block.
replacement_plans.next_action: Use the source-specific ingest audit to identify which route/page failed, then retry only that route with lower limits.
replacement_plans.do_not_do: Do not discard successful local records or reclassify the whole source as blocked because one route timed out.

replacement_plans.name: Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API
replacement_routes: Check whether the failed route is an individual item/detail endpoint while broader search/list endpoints still work.
Keep successful local records and mark missing detail routes in the source-specific ingest audit.
Prefer documented bulk/list APIs or lower-volume detail retries where terms allow.
replacement_plans.next_action: Review source-specific audit output before retrying; retry only the failed route class, not the entire source.
replacement_plans.do_not_do: Do not bypass 403 responses or treat item-level blocks as permission to scrape alternate restricted pages.
